articles.summary: TUPELO, Miss., Oct. 28, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The board of directors of Renasant Corporation (NYSE: RNST) approved the payment of a quarterly cash dividend of twenty-three cents ($0.23) per share to be paid January 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of December 18, 2025.
